biz_sticker_success_hero_subtitle: Zitikiti zanu zaulere za 'Bitcoin Imalandiridwa Pano' zikufika mu sabata 2–4 — mu envelopi yoyera yokhala ndi zitikiti 3.
biz_sticker_success_tip_1: Pa khomo lanu lakutsogolo kapena pa zenera kuti makasitomala awone asanalowe
biz_sticker_success_tip_2: Pafupi ndi kasha yanu, chosanjikiza cha POS, kapena malo olipirira
biz_sticker_success_tip_3: Pa menyu, mndandanda wa mitengo, kapena chosanjikiza cha tip
biz_sticker_success_tip_4: OSAYIKA pa katundu wopanda chilolezo kapena katundu osati wanu
biz_sticker_success_more_c1: Ngati zitikiti 3 zilibe ku bizinesi yanu, mukhoza kupempha zambiri zaulere — kapena kuodola zambiri kuchokera kwa wosindikiza yemwe ife timagwiritsa ntchito.
